message: Hi! Just want to say I will definitely order next month. Just budgeting now.
Hi, please I want to order 2 of this. How much total? And do you have it in [color]?
Oga, my mama say make I tell you say we need the food for the party on Saturday. Last price for 50 packs?
Oga, na the second time I dey message you. Wetin you dey wait for? I wan order today!
Customer, your price too much. I go comot. Last price before I go?
Oga, I have been your customer since. Why you wan increase the price like this?
Boss, the [item] wey I want, my budget get limit. Last price? I no fit pass [amount].
Oga, my guy dey Lagos. You fit send am give am through my brother? I go pay you sharp.
Wetin the difference between this one and the one wey dey [other seller]? Why you dey cost more?
Quick reply needed. My flight is in 3 hours. Can you make the delivery?
Oga, na you sabi. Last price? I no want argue with you. Just close am today.
I wan order but my account balance no reach. I will pay on Friday.
Boss, I know say you dey busy but abeg attend to me. I wan pay this morning.
I trust you, but my account is frozen. Can I pay cash on delivery? Please.
Hi! Are you open on Sunday? Want to bring cash and pick up my order directly.
My wife dey wait for the gold. Abeg try deliver am today sharp sharp.
Please I will appreciate if you can include the gift card with the delivery. Thanks.

Will pay on delivery. No need to send account. Just deliver to my address.

Oga, my guy don refer me. Na today I wan close this deal. Last price wey you go give.
Quick one - you dey open tomorrow? I wan come your office pay and collect.
Hi! I just received my order. Thank you so much! It looks great!
Boss, my guy say make I tell you say the [item] wey you sell, na original?

Customer, no be say I no wan pay. Money no dey reach. You go give me small time?
Quick check - is the price negotiable for bulk? I need 20 pieces.
Hi dear, I have a question. After I pay, how long before I get it? Same week?

Just browsing. How much is the laptop?

Just placed the order. Please send the confirmation. Also when to expect delivery?
Customer, na me be the person wey message you yesterday. You remember?
Customer, the last time wey I buy, the quality no too good. This time you go give me better?
I wan order but you no dey reply my messages. Wetin happen? You dey sell or no dey?
Customer, na today I wan decide. Last price wey you go give. I dey wait o.
I have made the transfer of [amount] to your account. Please find attached the receipt. Kindly confirm.
Please I would appreciate a callback today. I am ready to order but have a few questions.
Boss, na urgent matter. Last price? I dey pay you now now.
Boss, this [item] too good. I wan am. How much last? I go pay before close of work today.
Please confirm if same-day dispatch is available. I will pay extra for fast shipping.
